description: A quadruped robot designed for agile locomotion and velocity tracking, featuring four legs with 3-DOF each (hip, thigh, calf).
notes: The robot is a quadruped (legged). While it lacks manipulators for grasping, the robot_spec mentions a 'payload_support_position_m' on the base, indicating it can support/carry objects on its back. Support surfaces are inferred from the foot collision geoms.
